home.faq_subtitle: Answers to your questions about how the platform works.
home.faq_q1: How does the donation and receiving process work?
home.faq_a1: Simply, the donor adds the donation with details and city. Verified charities can browse donations, and when they find something suitable, they click 'Request Donation'. The donor receives a notification to start a conversation with the charity to arrange delivery.
home.faq_q2: What is the admin approval process for donations?
home.faq_a2: To ensure quality and safety, all donations first go through 'Under Review' in the admin dashboard. After verifying the image clarity and donation details, the admin approves it and it appears in the public list.
home.faq_a3: It is a social space for users who need help they can't find listed as a donation. You can write your request (material, emotional, or volunteer help) and the community will respond in the comments or through direct contact.
home.faq_q4: How can I volunteer on the platform?
home.faq_a4: Through the 'Volunteer' page, we post tasks. You can register with a click, and your volunteer hours will be added to your profile.
home.faq_q5: How can I track my donations?
home.faq_a5: Through your personal 'Dashboard', you'll find 'My Donations' and 'My Requests' sections. You can see statuses directly (Under Review, Available, Delivered) and edit or delete donations easily.
